chunks: Ali narrated from his father, from Ibn Faddal, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, from Abi Maryam, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام ruled concerning the nose of a slave, or his male organ, or anything whose loss encompasses his value, that he must pay to his master the value of the slave, and he takes the slave.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.الْعَبْدِ: the slave, as legal property in the ruling’s context
key_terms.قَضَى: issued a legal judgment or ruling
key_terms.قِيمَةَ الْعَبْدِ: the full price or value of the slave
key_terms.قِيمَتِهِ: his monetary value or assessed worth

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone causes an injury to a slave that equals the slave’s full value?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام regarding injury to a slave that effectively exhausts the slave’s full market value. In such a case, the injurer pays the slave’s full value to the owner and then takes possession of the slave.
